description: URL-valued markup and DOM properties distinguish a whole target from a component after a fixed prefix. The whole target can choose a script-bearing scheme (CWE-79); a prefixed value can alter path/query syntax but cannot choose the host (CWE-116). URL-component encoding clears only the URL contexts it addresses.

expected.note: HTML escaping does not constrain a whole URL's scheme
DOM URL property with a fixed prefix
